name: Hong Leong Financial Group Berhad
summary: Hong Leong Financial Group Berhad, an investment holding company, provides investment banking, stockbroking, and fund management business of financial services to consumer, corporate, and institutional customers. The company operates through Commercial Banking, Investment Banking and Asset Management, Insurance, and Other Operations segments. It also offers commercial and Islamic banking, including personal financial services, business & corporate banking, global markets, and Islamic financial services.
